title: Known-truth typed state handoff by layer-cut rescue and blocking
question: When do source and later-mapping counterfactuals become causally sufficient and necessary at the answer state?

hypothesis_predictions.observable: Layer-indexed rescue and blocking responses for source, mapping, joint, answer and control position groups.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: A typed write onset and later lock-in with correct identity selectivity repeats in at least four of six networks and every depth.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: The full conjunction fails breadth, timing is only an endpoint identity, or wrong-identity answer states are not separated.

hypothesis_predictions.observable: Same layer-cut interventions with matched-null and wrong-answer-identity controls.
hypothesis_predictions.expected: Endpoint sufficiency may hold by architecture while intermediate timing and identity fail to repeat across free implementations.
hypothesis_predictions.death_observation: The full typed handoff conjunction repeats across depth and identity controls.

data_contract.cluster_unit: One code-world with base, source, mapping, joint, wrong-source, wrong-mapping, wrong-joint and matched-null counterfactuals.

calibration.endpoints: origin group at embedding cut and answer group at final cut are algebraic instrument checks

data_contract.split_rule: No discovery or selection occurs; every layer and all six disjoint position groups are exhaustively evaluated.
data_contract.answer_payload_rule: Code source and later mapping are independently varied; joint changes both.

metrics.estimator: Origin and final-answer rescue error plus block remaining fraction.
Earliest answer rescue onset and earliest answer-block lock-in.
Matched-null response divided by smallest target response.

typed_gates.rule: At least four of six models and every depth pass behavior.
Origin-at-input and answer-at-final rescue/block identities pass in breadth.
Target effects exceed five and matched-null fraction is at most 0.08 in breadth.
Late correct answer-state rescue beats wrong identity by 0.40 and final wrong cosine is at most 0.50 in breadth.
All conditions have non-input write onset, later-or-equal lock-in, endpoint, specificity and identity in at least four models and every depth.

budget.right_censoring_rule: No replacement seeds, threshold relaxation, group merging, or layer selection.

stopping_rules: Endpoint identities are audits, not discoveries.
Full handoff requires breadth and identity.

adjudication.failure_claim: Endpoint and matched-null gates passed, but only two of six networks passed the full identity-conditioned handoff conjunction; write timing ranged from layer one to the final layer.
adjudication.reopen_condition: A future campaign must change the identity geometry or causal edge object and independently recalibrate it; thresholds and failed seeds remain frozen.

authorizes_on_pass: one fresh Qwen single-model typed handoff contract
authorizes_on_failure: retain answer-state late takeover as a bounded candidate
